title: Unidentified man found shot dead on the diversion road in Capiton, Datu Odin Sinsuat
summary: The body of an unidentified man was found along the Cotabato–Datu Odin Sinsuat Diversion Road in Barangay Capiton, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, at about 8:45 a.m. on Friday, 20 November 2026, after a resident reported a shooting there. Police said he had been shot by an unidentified gunman who fled before they arrived. His identity and the motive were not yet known, and the police had launched a hot pursuit.

sources.title: Unidentified Man Found Shot Dead Along Diversion Road in Datu Odin Sinsuat

title: Unidentified man shot dead in Sitio Dagurongan 1, Raguisi, Sultan Kudarat
summary: A man was shot dead in Sitio Dagurongan 1, Barangay Raguisi, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, on Friday, 20 November 2026, DXMS Radyo Bida reported. He had not yet been identified.

sources.title: JUST IN: Lalaki, patay sa pamamaril sa Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte
